entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Jane. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Apex Trail helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Preference, I guess. The color isn't what I thought it would be.
I understand. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be tricky. Let me just check the purchase date here... Okay, looks like it was delivered 77 days ago.
And you are well within our 90-day return window, so that's no problem at all. Can I just confirm the item is in its original condition? Is the box unopened?
Yes, the box is unopened. I knew right away I didn't want it.

Perfect. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially with something as important as safety equipment. I've just approved the return for that helmet. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now.

You should receive that email within the next 5 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any UPS location. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright then. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
